sources.comparison: Broader classical strip contraction, rapid-decay/evenness hypotheses, positive quadratic multiplier and explicit de Bruijn attribution. Theorem 3 is the classical finite-threshold antecedent; the paper reconstructs a finite-log-factor smoothing route without importing the measure classification.

limits: A bounded primary comparison, not a review of all subsequent constant bounds or the full Rodgers--Tao proof. General contraction and finite-threshold existence are classical.
